select 
    i_category, 
    i_class, 
    i_brand, 
    i_product_name, 
    d_year, 
    d_qoy, 
    d_moy, 
    s_store_id, 
    sumsales, 
    rk 
from (
    select 
        i_category, 
        i_class, 
        i_brand, 
        i_product_name, 
        d_year, 
        d_qoy, 
        d_moy, 
        s_store_id, 
        sumsales, 
        rank() over (partition by i_category order by sumsales desc) rk 
    from (
        select 
            i_category, 
            i_class, 
            i_brand, 
            i_product_name, 
            d_year, 
            d_qoy, 
            d_moy, 
            s_store_id, 
            sum(coalesce(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) sumsales 
        from (
            select 
                ss_item_sk, 
                ss_sold_date_sk, 
                ss_store_sk, 
                ss_sales_price, 
                ss_quantity 
            from store_sales 
            where ss_sold_date_sk in (
                select d_date_sk 
                from date_dim 
                where d_month_seq between 1217 and 1217 + 11
            )
        ) ss 
        join date_dim on ss.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
        join store on ss.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk 
        join item on ss.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
        group by 
            i_category, 
            i_class, 
            i_brand, 
            i_product_name, 
            d_year, 
            d_qoy, 
            d_moy, 
            s_store_id
    ) dw1 
    where rk <= 100
) dw2 
order by 
    i_category, 
    i_class, 
    i_brand, 
    i_product_name, 
    d_year, 
    d_qoy, 
    d_moy, 
    s_store_id, 
    sumsales, 
    rk 
limit 100
